place._theme: Quiet sites with residents; here they are the people being defended, so the words keep them alive.

prose.name: Defense: Raiders at the <Place> on <Planet>
prose.briefing: Raiders keep hitting the <Place> and taking whatever's cooking. The woman who runs its canteen wants someone on the door tonight.
prose.card: Local Contract. Hold the <Place> on <Planet> against raiders. Payment on contract completion.

beats.journal: Raiders came at the <Place> three times. I held the door while the woman who runs the canteen kept up a running commentary. They left without the dinner.
say: That's them gone, and the dinner's still on the stove. Come in and eat, you've earned the big bowl.

broadcast: Right, here's the running order. They turn up after dark, they make a lot of noise, and they leave with our dinner. Tonight they don't get the dinner, because you're on the door, and I've seen worse shots than you in my own kitchen.
